title: Unit cocycles on the standard projective-space cover
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], r>=3, P=projective space with r homogeneous coordinates over Spec k, U_i=D_+(T_i), and transitionUnit(d,i,j)=(T_i/T_j)^d [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. Let t_ij be a unit of Gamma(U_i intersection U_j,O_P) for every pair, including equal indices. Suppose that on every open W contained in U_i,U_j,U_l, the restrictions satisfy t_ij*t_jl=t_il. There exist an integer d and units a_i of Gamma(U_i,O_P) such that on every double overlap res(a_i)*t_ij=transitionUnit(d,i,j)*res(a_j). This concerns functions only and asserts no module classification or gluing.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, double- and triple-overlap calculation.

proof.text: For distinct indices i,j identify the overlap ring with k[t,t^-1,z], t=T_i/T_j. Polynomial degree in each z adds under products over a domain, so a unit and its inverse have degree zero in z. The greatest and least Laurent exponents also add; their difference for a unit is zero. Thus the unit is uniquely c_ij*(T_i/T_j)^e_ij with c_ij in k^*. These comparisons are compatible with restriction to triple overlaps.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, double- and triple-overlap calculation.

proof.text: For distinct i,j,l use the two independent Laurent variables T_i/T_j and T_j/T_l on their triple overlap. The assumed cocycle identity gives e_ij=e_jl=e_il and c_ij*c_jl=c_il by comparing coefficients. The identities with repeated indices give t_ii=1 and t_ji=t_ij^-1, so reversing a pair preserves its exponent. Every pair of edges is joined by triples when r>=3; hence all exponents equal one integer d.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, double- and triple-overlap calculation.

proof.text: Fix an index b. Put c_ii=1. The scalar equations give c_ij=c_ib/c_jb, including pairs involving b. On chart i choose the constant unit a_i=c_ib^-1. Then res(a_i)*t_ij=(T_i/T_j)^d*res(a_j) on every overlap. For i=j both sides equal a_i. This proves exactly the conclusion, without gluing any module.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, double- and triple-overlap calculation.

mathlib_searches.query: A cocycle of invertible regular functions on the standard charts of projective space over a field is a coboundary times a power of the coordinate ratios
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: group-cohomology coboundary and Hilbert-90 results, homological cocycles and Proj structure-sheaf fractions. No standard-cover unit normalization theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: A multiplicative Cech cocycle of units on standard projective space charts is a coboundary times a fixed integer power of coordinate ratios
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Hilbert 90, group coboundaries, Mobius denominators, homological cocycles and PresheafOfGroups.OneCohomologyRelation. The latter defines the relation but proves no normalization for projective space.

mathlib_searches.query: cocycle.*projective|projective.*cocycle|fiber.*projective|projective.*fiber; rg on repository and blueprint for projective unit cocycle and fibre twist model
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has two unrelated Proj stalkToFiberRingHom hits. Repository has transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit, proving the standard cocycle is a cocycle; it does not classify arbitrary unit cocycles. Projective-line results have only two coordinates. Full blueprint search found no duplicate normalization statement.

from.place: Fibre-degree proof step 2: normalize the unit cocycle on the standard cover in dimension at least two.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_standardUnitCocycle_normalization (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (t : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r),
      Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)),
        standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i ⊓ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j)ˣ)
    (ht : ∀ (i j l : ULift.{u} (Fin r))
      (W : ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)).Opens)
      (hi : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i)
      (hj : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j)
      (hl : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) l),
      (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)).op (t i j).val *
        (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_inf hj hl)).op (t j l).val =
        (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_inf hi hl)).op (t i l).val) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, ∃ a : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin r),
      Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)), standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i)ˣ,
      ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r),
        (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (a i).val * (t i j).val =
          (transitionUnit _ (Spec (.of k)) d i j).val *
            (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (a j).val
